om-0Tbz.title: Road: wide shoulders, red soil, north-west angle
om-0Tbz.summary: Wide shoulders like the long light-desert road, but heading more north-west with reddish soil. The eastern half is cloudy.

om-2Xid.title: Bin: black without sticker
om-2Xid.summary: Black bins without stickers are mainly on the north-west coast. Many black bins look sticker-free, so use with caution.

om-3ymS.title: Road: wide shoulders, darker, greener desert
om-3ymS.summary: Wide shoulders like the long light-desert road, but the desert is darker with more shrubs and greenery, and a long stretch is overcast. Further north it gets hillier and greener.

om-3yxy.title: Road: gas pipelines beside the road
om-3yxy.summary: Gas pipelines running along the road, most common in the north-west interior but also in pockets of the central south.

om-4S9b.title: Road: generic desert, very narrow shoulders
om-4S9b.summary: A generic road. Narrow or no shoulders is the best clue. The west gets hilly, but overall the desert is flat.

om-5EZS.title: Landscape: bumpy ridge, pipes, oil infrastructure
om-5EZS.summary: A bumpy, sloped ridge of hills with pipes and other oil equipment. Very distinct.

om-5P9r.title: Road: only divided road in flat desert
om-5P9r.summary: The only divided road crossing flat desert.

om-5QM5.title: Language: Arabic with English beside it
om-5QM5.summary: Arabic is the main language, and signs often add English because of tourism. The UAE does the same.

om-5ml1.title: Landscape: orange-pink sand, long low dunes
om-5ml1.summary: Dirt roads through slightly rolling orange-pink sand with small yellowish shrubs, running south-south-west between long low dunes.

om-6oTi.title: Road: unusually light pavement, dunes to the north
om-6oTi.summary: A stretch of road with uniquely light-coloured pavement and sand dunes to the north.

om-6sjg.title: Landscape: red sand dunes
om-6sjg.summary: Reddish dunes near the Saudi border and further inland in the middle.

om-80ME.title: Chevron: black-yellow, very many arrows
om-80ME.summary: Black-and-yellow chevron signs with an unusually high number of arrows.

om-BH5p.title: Road: hilly desert heading north
om-BH5p.summary: A road heading north through hilly desert.

om-Bmam.title: Pylon: red and white painted
om-Bmam.summary: High-voltage pylons painted in a red and white pattern are common. Qatar has them less often.

om-DD2W.title: Bin: black or grey, three-leaf logo, "be'ah"
om-DD2W.summary: Black plastic or grey metal bins with a three-leaf logo and the text be'ah. UAE bins sometimes say bee'ah with two Es and are often more colourful.

differs.how: Text is spelled bee'ah and bins are more colourful

om-EFME.title: Landscape: desert, dry mountains on the north coast
om-EFME.summary: Mostly desert with little vegetation. The middle and south are flat; the north coast has dry mountains like the UAE, and the south coast has less dry mountains.

om-FKcd.title: Coverage: small desert tracks
om-FKcd.summary: The drivers covered many small tracks deep in the desert.

om-GuYj.title: Road: scenic coast with tall light-coloured cliffs
om-GuYj.summary: A scenic coastal road east of the southern city with lots of tall, light-coloured rocky cliffs, and the sea often visible.

om-HDvc.title: Bin: grey without front sticker
om-HDvc.summary: Grey bins with no front sticker are found in the north-west coast area. They may have a sticker on the side.

om-HEHv.title: Plants: short flat-topped acacia trees
om-HEHv.summary: Short acacia trees with flat, umbrella-like crowns. Most common in the north, but also found near the rest of the coast.

om-HxCO.title: Road: north-west angle, power line left, farms
om-HxCO.summary: A north-west heading road with a power line on the left and signs of life like farms or buildings. Not to be confused with a similar-angle road that is emptier and can have sunset coverage.

om-I0iI.title: Landscape: sharp ridge with rugged hills south
om-I0iI.summary: A ridge like the one near the southern city but more pronounced, with more rugged hills just south of it.

om-IhpD.title: Road: unpaved, sunset coverage, dust trail
om-IhpD.summary: An unpaved road with sunset coverage and a dust trail behind the car.

om-JI8b.title: Bin: black with white sticker
om-JI8b.summary: Black bins with a white sticker are found in the central region, the far south and the capital area.

om-JOck.title: Landscape: flat coast with mountains to the north
om-JOck.summary: A flat coastal plain with rolling mountains to the north.

om-KCpU.title: Coverage: overcast with power line on the west
om-KCpU.summary: An overcast stretch with a power line to the west of the road, only north of a plateau.

om-KQ3f.title: Road: flat pink-grey desert, bad road, no lines
om-KQ3f.summary: Like the border road, flat pink-grey desert, but the road is in poor shape with no lines and heads south-east.

om-LudA.title: Road: very light sand, coast in the distance
om-LudA.summary: One of the sandiest landscapes, with very light sand everywhere. The coast is sometimes visible, and on the north-south stretch a ridge is visible far to the west.

om-NCuJ.title: Coverage: hazy, ridge and hills to the north
om-NCuJ.summary: Usually hazy coverage with the ridge and hills to the north, sometimes only one or two visible. Unlike just north of it, there are no mountains in other directions.

om-O076.title: Bin: grey with black sticker on front
om-O076.summary: Grey bins with a black front sticker are found in the north-west interior.

om-ROkr.title: Landscape: jagged rocky mountains with green bushes
om-ROkr.summary: North of the central town: very rocky, jagged mountains with unusually many green bushes for the north. The southern mountains are more rounded.

om-SjQ3.title: Bin: small western-style black bins
om-SjQ3.summary: Small western-style black bins are found around the capital and the eastern part of the north-west coast.

om-SviY.title: Road: flat pink-grey desert, very wide shoulders
om-SviY.summary: A road to the Saudi border with completely flat desert, bright pink-grey soil, very wide shoulders and great condition. The south part is straight north-east; the north part curves and has more shrubs.

om-UPn7.title: Road: oil drills
om-UPn7.summary: Oil drills are common near one town in the interior, sometimes seen along one main road and north-west of another town.

om-VDcS.title: Road: small white marks between the dashes
om-VDcS.summary: An unlabelled road recognised by small white markings between the dashes.

om-VaWE.title: Landscape: urban area ringed by mountains
om-VaWE.summary: Mountains on all sides in a somewhat urban area means just south-east of the capital.

om-W4Kz.title: Road: light flat desert, wide shoulders, faded lines
om-W4Kz.summary: A long stretch of light flat desert with wide shoulders, often faded road lines and mostly cloudy weather.

om-WJdu.title: Bin: colour hints at the region
om-WJdu.summary: Bin colour narrows down the region on the map. Purple areas are mixed, and even the dark blue and red areas are not 100% certain.

om-WjNO.title: Sign: blue direction sign, Arabic and English
om-WjNO.summary: Blue direction signs with white text, usually in Arabic and English. The UAE and Qatar use similar signs.

om-WvdB.title: Landscape: flat grey desert, ridge and two hills
om-WvdB.summary: Flat desert with grey soil, one long ridge to the south, two small round hills to the east and south-east, and other mountains to the north and west.

om-XuIA.title: Bin: white-and-red chevron stickers
om-XuIA.summary: Bins around the capital often have white-and-red chevron-like stickers on the sides.

om-Y1wA.title: Road: very wide unpaved road, pale soil
om-Y1wA.summary: A very wide unpaved road with light-coloured soil. Oil drills sometimes appear in the distance.

om-ZG0K.title: Curb: black and yellow
om-ZG0K.summary: Black-and-yellow striped curbs are common. The UAE commonly has similar ones.

om-cWlW.title: Landscape: dry mountains in the north
om-cWlW.summary: The north has dry mountains like eastern UAE. The south coast rarely has similar ones.

om-eWEb.title: Houses: light stone, blocky but ornate, fenced
om-eWEb.summary: Blocky but ornate houses of light-coloured stone, with a matching fence and often an even fancier gate. UAE buildings are often very similar.

om-gjTm.title: Landscape: very dry orange mountains, tilted layers
om-gjTm.summary: In the northern exclave: drier mountains, often with an orange tone and tilted diagonal rock layers, like the UAE. The rest of the country has somewhat shrubby mountains.

differs.how: Looks very similar; exclave has more in common with UAE

om-hang.title: Landscape: lone crown-shaped mountain
om-hang.summary: A prominent lone mountain, wider than tall and shaped like a crown, visible from far away just south-east of the central town.

om-hirx.title: Road: only a white middle line, grey sandy desert
om-hirx.summary: Only a white centre line plus a grey sandy desert makes this road unique.

om-hxXh.title: Sign: black-and-white striped signposts
om-hxXh.summary: Many signposts are striped black and white. In the Middle East only Oman and the UAE have them.

om-iwBJ.title: Google car: forward-facing antenna
om-iwBJ.summary: An antenna pointing forward is only found in and around the capital.

om-kcH3.title: Landscape: dry hilly island, grey soil
om-kcH3.summary: A dry, slightly hilly island with greyish soil and brown shrubs. The ring road usually has only a white centre line, and the front camera looks smudged.

om-l5p8.title: Road: shrubby desert, low jagged hills, low sun
om-l5p8.summary: A fairly shrubby landscape with low jagged mountains on the east side and a low sun to the north-west.

om-lm-15347.title: Landscape: large orange-pink dunes
om-lm-15347.summary: A road through large orange-pink sand dunes in the south-west. The same dunes are visible in the distance near the northern Yemen border.

om-m9r7.title: Road: hills, green shrubs, curved lamp posts
om-m9r7.summary: Surrounded by hills and mountains with ground covered in green shrubs, and curved lamp posts at regular intervals on the north-east side.

om-mBfi.title: Bin: black with black sticker on front
om-mBfi.summary: Black bins with a black sticker on the front are found in the north-east, including the capital area.

om-muqQ.title: Bin: grey with white sticker
om-muqQ.summary: Grey bins with a white sticker are common in the central region and sometimes in the far south.

om-n8zU.title: Plate: yellow private, red commercial
om-n8zU.summary: Private vehicles have yellow plates and commercial vehicles have red plates.

om-nfDe.title: Bin: side sticker means north coast
om-nfDe.summary: If a bin has a sticker on its side, whatever its colour, you should be on the north coast.

om-qr8t.title: Google car: white pickup truck, usually fully blurred
om-qr8t.summary: The coverage was shot from a white pickup truck. It is usually blurred out completely, but you may see the antenna or the front.

om-qxO7.title: Road: light shoulders, faded white middle line
om-qxO7.summary: Two roads heading east-west through slightly hilly sunny desert, with light-coloured shoulders and a faded white middle line. On one the sun is overhead; on the other it is to the west.

om-rqum.title: Bin: number codes give the region
om-rqum.summary: Many bins carry numbers: the first pair gives the governorate, the second pair a smaller division. The map does not list every code.

om-t06U.title: Plants: date palm plantations on the north coast
om-t06U.summary: Date palm plantations are most common on the northern coast. Coconut palms are usually found near the south.

om-t0HH.title: Road: generic flat desert heading north-west
om-t0HH.summary: Very generic flat desert, and the north-west angle is the best clue. South half: a big power line to the north-east. North half: sunset coverage.

om-tSZ6.title: Coverage: coastal road, rocky cliffs, sea to the west
om-tSZ6.summary: In the northern exclave: coastal road with rocky cliffs hugging it. Most of it has the sea on the west.

om-tnDu.title: Landscape: green farm patches in the desert
om-tnDu.summary: Patches of green farmland surrounded by desert.

om-v23h.title: Landscape: rolling hills, rocks, green valleys
om-v23h.summary: Near the south coast: rolling hills with rocky ground, bushes, small trees and some fairly green valleys.

om-vDCC.title: Road lines: yellow edge, white middle
om-vDCC.summary: Yellow edge lines with white centre lines. The same is common in the UAE, Israel and Jordan, and occasionally in Qatar.

om-vKos.title: Landscape: sandy desert, light green-yellow shrubs
om-vKos.summary: Sandy desert with light green and yellow shrubs in the north-east, mainly south and west of one town.

om-wuX6.title: Taxi: white with orange side panels
om-wuX6.summary: White taxis with orange panels on each side.

om-zeu8.title: Google car: upward-facing antenna
om-zeu8.summary: A normal-looking upright antenna, mainly around and west of the capital and on north-west highways, with a few spots elsewhere in the north.

om-zoUC.title: Pole: wooden with three kinds of tops
om-zoUC.summary: Wooden poles with three top designs: two have three insulators on a horizontal bar, one has a metal triangle above the pole (unique here), and one has the insulators on the side. Poles are more common than in the UAE or Qatar.
